Self.Wiki: This map object represents an in-game object of varying sizes, from clutter to cliffs. Supports in-built collision, however not all objects use it.

AssetSfxParamRelativeID.Wiki: The SFX ID for this object to use (added to the base ModelSfxParam ID).

CollisionTypeOverride.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param Collision Type: 11 to 16 use that type, 0 uses the param's.

PickUpItemLotParamID.Wiki: The item lot given when the asset is picked up.

BreakItemLotParamID.Wiki: The item lot given when the asset is broken.
